question: 统计各分类的已发布文章数量，包含没有已发布文章的分类
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS published_count FROM tb_category c LEFT JOIN tb_blog_post p ON p.category_id=c.id AND p.status=1 GROUP BY c.id,c.name ORDER BY c.id

question: 查询浏览量最高的三篇已发布文章
sql: SELECT title,view_count FROM tb_blog_post WHERE status=1 ORDER BY view_count DESC,id LIMIT 3

question: 找出没有文档搜索也没有网页搜索的会话
sql: SELECT c.id,c.name FROM ai_conversation c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_doc_search d WHERE d.conversation_id=c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_web_search w WHERE w.conversation_id=c.id) ORDER BY c.id

question: 统计未回复咨询数量，包括匿名咨询
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unreplied_count FROM tb_consultation WHERE reply_status=0 AND reply_time IS NULL

question: 统计每个标签关联的已发布文章数
sql: SELECT t.name,COUNT(p.id) AS published_count FROM tb_tag t LEFT JOIN tb_post_tag pt ON pt.tag_id=t.id LEFT JOIN tb_blog_post p ON p.id=pt.post_id AND p.status=1 GROUP BY t.id,t.name ORDER BY t.id
